in_latin.name: Stavros
in_latin.long_meaning: Stavros significat crucis signum in lingua Graeca. Origine a verbo Graeco 'stauromai' significans 'crucifigere'. In traditione Christiana, Stavros commemorat passionem et resurrectionem Domini nostri Iesu Christi. Nomen Stavros inductum est ab apparitione Domini post resurrectionem in via Emmaus, ubi discipuli Domini cognoverunt eum in pane et in vino. Stavros est nomen significans fidem et crucem Domini nostri, et est donatum mulieribus, viris, et pueris in traditione Christiana.

in_english.name: Stavros
in_english.meaning: Sign of the Cross, crucified, symbol of Christian faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Stavros originates from the Greek verb 'stauromai' meaning 'to crucify'. In the Christian tradition, Stavros commemorates the Passion and Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ. The name Stavros was introduced by the Lord's post-resurrection appearance on the road to Emmaus, where disciples recognized Him in bread and wine. Stavros is a name signifying faith and the Cross of the Lord, and is given to women, men, and children in the Christian tradition. As a name, Stavros symbolizes the ultimate sacrifice and redemption through Christ's crucifixion and resurrection, reflecting the core values of Christian faith.

The name is a constant reminder of Jesus Christ's crucifixion and the redemptive power of the cross. Carrying the name Stavros can be thought of as a badge of honor, a sign of one's deep faith and dedication to their spiritual beliefs.
